philosophy: Acceptance criteria verify scientific validity, procedural correctness, and provenance integrity, NOT whether arbitrary metric thresholds were exceeded. Poor empirical performance is a valid scientific finding; fabricated or unvalidated execution is an invalid failure.

repository_level_invariants.no_fabrication: Zero mock, synthetic substitute, dummy, precomputed, or hardcoded metrics.
repository_level_invariants.no_silent_fallback: If physical dataset is missing or schema mismatches, runner fails closed immediately with FileNotFoundError or ValueError.
repository_level_invariants.external_dataset_firewall: No unseen external evaluation dataset is selected, searched, inspected, or evaluated during this phase.
repository_level_invariants.no_hyperparameter_optimization: No tuning, grid search, random search, or post-hoc adjustments to learning rates, architectures, or weights.
repository_level_invariants.historical_artifact_immutability: Historical artifacts in benchmarks/results/raw/ are strictly read-only and preserved for scientific auditability.
